translation.name: Musinsa Kicks Seongsu
translation.summary: A shoe-focused select shop near Seongsu Station combining footwear curation, fitting and smart in-store shopping features.
translation.description: Musinsa Kicks Seongsu connects Seongsu's long shoe-making history with contemporary footwear retail. The multi-level store carries a wide range of footwear categories and provides a practical stop for travelers interested in Korean fashion and sneaker culture.
translation.local_tip: It is very close to Seongsu Station, so it works well as either the first or last stop of a Seongsu shopping route.
